missions.name: Broken Frontier
missions.briefing: Armoured breakthrough. The Ljubljana gap, where the road up from Trieste opens onto the plain and the border posts are still burning.

missions.name: Iron Corridor
missions.briefing: Defensive line. The Drava–Sava flatland east of Osijek: maize, dykes, and a road net with no cover anywhere on it.

missions.name: Mountain Shield
missions.briefing: Urban assault. The ridges above the city, where every valley road is observed from two sides at once.

missions.name: Silent Thunder
missions.briefing: Amphibious landing. The Kacanik defile and the passes either side of it, the only wheeled route south.

missions.name: Baltic Sentinel
missions.briefing: Airborne assault. The port, the spit and the channel between them; the sea does half the defending and the weather the rest.

missions.name: Frozen Spear
missions.briefing: Convoy escort. The ore railway and the fjord it ends at, in a January with four hours of light.

missions.name: Black Sea Watch
missions.briefing: Encirclement. The port and the Dobruja steppe behind it: flat, dry, and open to anything that can reach the coast.

missions.name: Carpathian Storm
missions.briefing: Reconnaissance. The Prahova valley passes, where a battalion astride the road is worth a brigade beside it.

missions.name: Northern Bastion
missions.briefing: Special forces raid. The island sitting across the middle of the Baltic; whoever holds it holds the sea lanes either side.

missions.name: Crimean Shadow
missions.briefing: Artillery suppression. The approaches to Sevastopol and the high ground behind the bays.

missions.name: Suwalki Line
missions.briefing: Air-defence operation. Sixty-five kilometres of forest and lake between two borders, and one road worth the name.

missions.name: Arctic Lance
missions.briefing: Extraction. The tundra east of the Tana, in polar night, where the going decides the plan.

missions.name: Vistula Shield
missions.briefing: Delaying action. The ground between the two cities: river crossings, rail junctions, and no natural line to hold.

missions.name: Baltic Breaker
missions.briefing: Bridge seizure. The Daugava through the middle of a capital, and the bridges that decide who holds which half.

missions.name: Final Rampart
missions.briefing: Combined-arms battle. The corridor every plan of the last fifty years was written around, fought over at last.

missions.name: Desert Scorpion
missions.briefing: Airborne assault. An oasis and an airstrip with six hundred kilometres of nothing around them.

missions.name: Red Dunes
missions.briefing: Convoy escort. The berm and the erg beyond it: mines, sand, and a line drawn across open desert.

missions.name: Black River
missions.briefing: Encirclement. The old quarter and the roundabouts, in streets a vehicle column cannot turn round in.

missions.name: Savanna Shield
missions.briefing: Reconnaissance. Scrub and dry riverbeds west of Turkana, where the tracks are the only going.

missions.name: Congo Thunder
missions.briefing: Special forces raid. The river bend and the falls, and a city reachable only along the water or the one road.

missions.name: Nile Sentinel
missions.briefing: Artillery suppression. The dam, the high ground over it, and a reservoir behind that nobody can be allowed to breach.

missions.name: Horn of Fire
missions.briefing: Air-defence operation. Trench lines on a highland plateau, dug through two wars and never filled in.

missions.name: Atlas Fortress
missions.briefing: Extraction. Passes at three thousand metres, one road each, and snow closing them at both ends.

missions.name: Sahara Spear
missions.briefing: Delaying action. The Hoggar massif and the pistes through it, where navigation is the enemy before anybody is.

missions.name: Desert Rebellion
missions.briefing: Bridge seizure. The coast road and a city astride it, desert on one flank and the sea on the other.

missions.name: Sahel Storm
missions.briefing: Combined-arms battle. The Niger crossing at the edge of the desert, and the tracks north that lead into it.

missions.name: Lake Chad Line
missions.briefing: Armoured breakthrough. Marsh, islands, and a shoreline that has moved fifty kilometres in a lifetime.

missions.name: Red Sea Shield
missions.briefing: Defensive line. The harbour, the tank farm, and the escarpment road inland: the country's one way to the sea.

missions.name: Congo Fortress
missions.briefing: Urban assault. A city between a volcano and a lake, with one airfield and no room behind it.

missions.name: Cape Sentinel
missions.briefing: Amphibious landing. The peninsula and the naval base on it, with a mountain in the middle of the battlefield.

missions.name: Dragon Gate
missions.briefing: Special forces raid. The truce village and the corridor south of it, four kilometres of the most heavily prepared ground on earth.

missions.name: Mountain Viper
missions.briefing: Artillery suppression. The Line of Control above the Vale, where a position is held by whoever can be supplied at altitude.

missions.name: Pacific Shield
missions.briefing: Air-defence operation. A hundred and thirty kilometres of water, and the beaches at each end of the crossing.

missions.name: Himalayan Fortress
missions.briefing: Extraction. The Indus valley at four thousand metres, where thin air costs every engine a third of its power.

missions.name: Steppe Thunder
missions.briefing: Delaying action. Open steppe to the horizon in every direction; nothing stops a manoeuvre here except another manoeuvre.

missions.name: Desert Falcon
missions.briefing: Bridge seizure. Shifting dunes and the desert highway across them, the only fixed thing for four hundred kilometres.

missions.name: Eastern Spear
missions.briefing: Combined-arms battle. The central mountain spine, where the valleys run the wrong way for an advance and the ridges do the fighting.

missions.name: Island Fortress
missions.briefing: Armoured breakthrough. An island of airbases with no depth, defended at the waterline or not at all.

missions.name: Sea Dragon
missions.briefing: Defensive line. Reefs, a runway built on one of them, and open water in every direction.

missions.name: Frozen Frontier
missions.briefing: Urban assault. The northern plain in deep winter: the classic ground, in the classic weather.

missions.name: Himalayan Storm
missions.briefing: Amphibious landing. A plateau above the Siliguri corridor; whoever holds it looks down on everything below.

missions.name: Strait Guardian
missions.briefing: Airborne assault. The northern approaches and the islands in them, inside artillery range of both shores.

missions.name: Pacific Trident
missions.briefing: Convoy escort. The Batanes channels: deep water, small islands, and the gate between two seas.

missions.name: Dragon's Reach
missions.briefing: Encirclement. The southern reefs, held by garrisons nobody can reinforce quickly.

missions.name: Eastern Horizon
missions.briefing: Reconnaissance. The eastern end of the line, where the mountains reach the sea and the fog closes for days.

missions.name: Northern Watch
missions.briefing: Delaying action. An island airfield in the North Pacific, where the weather grounds aircraft more reliably than air defence.

missions.name: Arctic Passage
missions.briefing: Bridge seizure. Lake, rock and muskeg: ground that carries a vehicle in February and swallows it in August.

missions.name: Pacific Gate
missions.briefing: Combined-arms battle. The strait, the naval base, and a coastline of inlets nobody can watch at once.

missions.name: Frozen Shield
missions.briefing: Armoured breakthrough. The inlet, the port, and the single road and rail line out of the city.

missions.name: Desert Sentinel
missions.briefing: Defensive line. Saguaro flats and dry washes, with visibility to the horizon and shade for nobody.

missions.name: Northern Spear
missions.briefing: Urban assault. The Alaska Highway and the river valleys it follows: one road, and everything depends on it.

missions.name: Pacific Thunder
missions.briefing: Amphibious landing. The bay, the coast highway, and a marine layer that hides both until ten in the morning.

missions.name: Rocky Fortress
missions.briefing: Airborne assault. The passes over the divide, closed by weather as often as by anybody defending them.

missions.name: Arctic Storm
missions.briefing: Convoy escort. A settlement, an airstrip, and open tundra resupplied by air or not at all.

missions.name: Great Lakes Shield
missions.briefing: Encirclement. The largest freshwater sea in the world, and the ore ports around its rim.

missions.name: Broken Border
missions.briefing: Reconnaissance. Desert plain either side of a line on the map, where the crossings are the only things that matter.

missions.name: Aleutian Spear
missions.briefing: Special forces raid. The deepest harbour in the chain, in the worst weather in the chain.

missions.name: Northern Rampart
missions.briefing: Artillery suppression. The port at the end of the rail line, and a bay that freezes solid around it.

missions.name: Pacific Fortress
missions.briefing: Air-defence operation. The sound, the yards on it, and a hundred kilometres of shoreline to cover.

missions.name: Arctic Dominion
missions.briefing: Extraction. The oil field, the haul road south, and the sea ice north: no cover on any of them.

missions.name: Amazon Spear
missions.briefing: Defensive line. The meeting of the waters, and a city of two millions reachable by river and air alone.

missions.name: Andean Shield
missions.briefing: Urban assault. The high valleys above Cusco, where the passes are the campaign and everything else is approach.

missions.name: Jungle Viper
missions.briefing: Amphibious landing. Triple canopy, river tracks, and clearings that close again in a season.

missions.name: Southern Fortress
missions.briefing: Airborne assault. Steppe, ice fields, and a wind that never stops; cover here is terrain, not vegetation.

missions.name: Orinoco Thunder
missions.briefing: Convoy escort. The river, the bridge at Ciudad Bolivar, and the savanna either side of it.

missions.name: Highland Storm
missions.briefing: Encirclement. The altiplano at four thousand metres: salt flats, volcanoes, and the passes between them.

missions.name: Amazon Sentinel
missions.briefing: Reconnaissance. The delta, the port, and a road net that ends where the forest begins.

missions.name: Pacific Spear
missions.briefing: Special forces raid. The driest desert on earth, the coast road through it, and the mining rail beside that.

missions.name: Jungle Fortress
missions.briefing: Artillery suppression. Llanos and gallery forest, with a river for a border and no line on the ground at all.

missions.name: Southern Cross
missions.briefing: Air-defence operation. The channel, the island, and a garrison at the end of the world in midwinter.

missions.name: Andean Thunder
missions.briefing: Extraction. The avenue of volcanoes: cloud forest on both slopes, and one road along the spine.

missions.name: Green Inferno
missions.briefing: Delaying action. Flooded forest for a hundred kilometres, where the map is a guess and the river is the road.

missions.name: Orinoco Shield
missions.briefing: Bridge seizure. The industrial belt on the lower river: dams, smelters, and the bridges that serve them.

missions.name: Patagonian Spear
missions.briefing: Combined-arms battle. The coast at Comodoro, the oil field behind it, and gravel roads between the two.

missions.name: Amazon Dominion
missions.briefing: Armoured breakthrough. The main channel and the towns strung along it, each one a day apart by boat.

missions.name: Southern Watch
missions.briefing: Convoy escort. The harbour and the airfields around it: the northern door, and everything comes through it.

missions.name: Coral Sentinel
missions.briefing: Encirclement. The port and the training area behind it, in the middle of the wet season.

missions.name: Outback Spear
missions.briefing: Reconnaissance. The gap through the MacDonnells, the one road north, and the one rail line beside it.

missions.name: Western Shield
missions.briefing: Special forces raid. The coastal plain and the naval anchorage on it, with two thousand kilometres of nothing behind.

missions.name: Timor Gate
missions.briefing: Artillery suppression. The shallow sea between two coasts, the gas fields in it, and the air routes over the top.

missions.name: Red Desert
missions.briefing: Air-defence operation. Dune fields running east and west for four hundred kilometres, crossed by tracks in two places.

missions.name: Coral Fortress
missions.briefing: Extraction. Reef, channel and cay: navigable water in narrow lanes and nothing at all outside them.

missions.name: Southern Spear
missions.briefing: Delaying action. The Derwent, the bridge across it, and highland country behind that closes in winter.

missions.name: Pacific Sentinel
missions.briefing: Bridge seizure. The river through a city, the port at its mouth, and the range at its back.

missions.name: Northern Rampart
missions.briefing: Combined-arms battle. Three hundred kilometres of highway between the port and the airbase, savanna either side.

missions.name: Outback Thunder
missions.briefing: Armoured breakthrough. The prohibited area: a range the size of a country, with one road across it and radars on it.

missions.name: Coral Shield
missions.briefing: Defensive line. The peninsula in the wet, where the tracks are impassable and the rivers are the only lines.

missions.name: Arafura Storm
missions.briefing: Urban assault. Shallow water, scattered islands, and the shortest crossing to the north.

missions.name: Southern Bastion
missions.briefing: Amphibious landing. The harbour, the heads, and a city built around both.

missions.name: Last Horizon
missions.briefing: Airborne assault. The sea approach and the coast behind it, fought together: the last door left open.
